critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~480 lines — still single-file, manageable. Models, routes, and helpers cleanly separated.
Razorpay placeholder detection uses string-suffix heuristic (.endswith('placeholder'/'secret')) — works but fragile; consider an explicit RAZORPAY_ENABLED=false env flag.
/api/payments/upi-notify is unauthenticated — anyone with a booking_id can mark it paid. Acceptable for current MVP since admin must verify, but flag this as risk.
send_booking_email exception path only logs; consider persisting email delivery status on the booking doc for admin visibility.
Frontend title is being overwritten in App.js useEffect — index.html meta is fine; this is the only branding leak that still references Pune.

rca of the issue: The 'Krishna' brand leakage exists in 3 frontend files (App.js, RateUs.jsx, Services.jsx) — these were missed during the rebrand to 'Krishn Tour and Travels'. App.js useEffect runs on mount and overwrites the correct index.html <title>, hence browser tab shows the old name plus wrong city ('Pune'). Fix: rename strings in those 3 files to 'Krishn Tour and Travels' and 'Ahmedabad'.
